text:
maya: Quick sync — need to lock scope for private deploy network ownership & upgrade paths. Field asks piling up; customers want the ability to manage peering/IPs and do in-place upgrades with minimal downtime. Can we align on launch criteria by EOW?

sam: +1. We should separate 'customer-managed networking' (they own routing/peers) vs 'handshake' (we provide a controlled ingress/egress). Which do we target for GA?

liam: From infra: two viable paths
- handshake-only: we control control-plane; customer provides static peering + routing. simpler upgrades.
- customer-managed: we ship a connector agent and hand off routing; more surface area (certs, KMS). Both need upgrade agent and migration hooks.

rosa: Customer asks: zero outbound egress to Redwood control plane. Any pathways for an airgapped or outbound-blocking install?

sam: Airgap is bigger. Short-term we can support an offline bundle and a relay proxy. Installer already has an offline mode prototype.

liam: Example of proposed installer config snippet for customer-managed mode:

```
network:
  mode: customer-managed
  peering:
    cidr: 10.10.0.0/16
upgrade:
  strategy: canary
  max_downtime: 5m
```

liam: Note: customer-managed requires documented expected ip ranges + clear cert rotation path.

jules: Legal flagged cert rotation SLA + IP ownership in contracts. FinCo also requires dedicated subnet and cert rotation within 24h.

maya: Draft launch criteria (proposal):
1) Handshake + customer-managed peering validated in 3 enterprise pilot installs.
2) In-place upgrade workflow with median downtime < 5m across test runs.
3) Installer offline bundle and signed artifacts available.
4) Docs, support runbook, and rollback playbook published.
5) KMS/HSM key management integration documented.

rosa: Add support readiness: training + 10 runbook playbooks (network, cert rotation, rollback, upgrade failover).

sam: Engineering asks: define target testbeds (AWS, GCP, on-prem k8s). Also need explicit config matrix for peering (static IPs, BGP, transit).

maya: Action items: @liam run perf + handshake vs customer-managed latency & failure matrix by Wed; @sam scope offline installer flow + bundle signing; @rosa draft support runbook; @jules confirm legal/contract must-haves. Meeting Fri 10am to finalize.

devops-bot: artifact uploaded — installers/0.9.3/installer-0.9.3.tgz (s3://redwood-prod/installers/0.9.3)

jules: Putting FinCo in priority canary cohort — they want dedicated subnet + cert SLA.

liam: I'll add test cases to infra pipeline and a small K8s onprem cluster run. :hammer_and_wrench:

maya: Thanks team — will track in the roadmap epic and post a short summary in the customer channel after Fri sync. :memo:
